title: The local class of the derived-section unit on an arbitrary complex
statement: Let Y be a ringed space and suppose its module-sheaf category has the chosen derived category. Let I be any integer cochain complex of module sheaves and q an integer. Write F for abelian presheaf sections, R for its recorded right-derived functor, H for derived homology of abelian presheaves, and U for inclusion of abelian sheaves into presheaves. Let u_I:Q(FI)→R(QI) be the derived unit, transported through quotientCompQhIso. Then H(u_I), followed by topEdgeLocalClass at QI and F(homologyFunctorFactors_I), equals homologyFunctorFactors_FI followed by the abelian sheafification unit and U(localSectionComplexSheafificationIso(Y,q,I)). No K-injectivity of I is assumed. The named comparisons are those of [lem-trf-unbounded-direct-image-section-presheaf] and [lem-weil-pbc-derived-adjunction-top-edge].

source.place: Tag 01E4, lemma-describe-higher-direct-images, bounded-below-complex local class calculation; Tags 0BKJ and 0D5X

proof.text: Lift a derived comparison between K-injective representatives to a complex map. Naturality of the resolution model and its prescribed sheafification comparison gives normalization on every K-injective representative.

Choose a K-injective resolution s:I→J. The derived unit followed by the comparison for s is Q(Fs). Naturality of the ordinary sheafification comparison and homologyFunctorFactors, followed by cancellation of H(s), identifies the sheafified unit on I with the ordinary comparison.
Apply the inclusion U and the naturality equation of the sheafification adjunction unit. This is the displayed local-class identity.

theorem localHypercohomology_complexUnit_class
    {Y : RingedSpace.{u}}
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y))]
    (q : ℤ) (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y)) ℤ) :
    let F := RingedSpace.localAbelianSections Y
    let U := sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor ((Opens Y)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}) q
    H.map ((DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso _).inv.app
        ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I) ≫
      (F.rightDerivedFunctorOfQuasiIsoResolutionsUnit
        (RingedSpace.localSectionsEnoughKInjectives Y)).app
          ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj I) ≫
      (RingedSpace.derivedLocalAbelianSections Y).map
        ((DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso _).hom.app I)) ≫
        RingedSpace.topEdgeLocalClass Y q (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I) ≫
        F.map ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors _ q).hom.app I) =
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors _ q).hom.app
          ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I) ≫
        (sheafificationAdjunction (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).unit.app
          (((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I).homology q) ≫
        U.map (RingedSpace.localSectionComplexSheafificationIso Y q I).hom
